GPU-resident CUDA BHO benchmark (Google Colab)¶

This notebook runs a real CUDA implementation on an NVIDIA GPU and compares it with sequential CPU, OpenMP CPU, and CUDA implementations using the same search equations.

What executes on the GPU: population initialization, candidate generation, objective-function evaluation, and greedy selection. The population and fitness arrays stay in device memory throughout the optimization loop; only the final best score is copied back. The global-best scan is also launched on the GPU (currently a simple one-thread scan, which can be optimized later).

Important algorithm note: the original BHO source includes K-means representative/group initialization, QPRS reassignment, and Explorpolis diversity admission. This notebook implements a GPU-resident BHO-inspired variant of its best-guided/peer-guided search, not a line-by-line CUDA port of every mechanism in the paper. Its CPU and CUDA versions are matched to each other for fair timing and score comparisons. Do not describe it as an exact reproduction of the paper's full BHO algorithm.

1. Select an NVIDIA GPU runtime¶

In Colab: Runtime → Change runtime type → T4 GPU (or another available GPU), then run the cells from top to bottom. This notebook deliberately stops if CUDA tools or an NVIDIA GPU are unavailable.

import torch
import time

print("PyTorch:", torch.__version__)
print("CUDA available:", torch.cuda.is_available())

if torch.cuda.is_available():
    print("GPU:", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))

    # Allocate data directly on the GPU
    a = torch.randn((4096, 4096), device="cuda")
    b = torch.randn((4096, 4096), device="cuda")

    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    start = time.perf_counter()

    for _ in range(30):
        c = torch.matmul(a, b)

    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start

    print(f"GPU computation completed in {elapsed:.3f} seconds")
    print(
        "GPU memory allocated:",
        round(torch.cuda.memory_allocated() / 1024**2, 1),
        "MiB"
    )
else:
    print("CUDA is unavailable to PyTorch.")

2. Write the CPU and CUDA source files¶

The sources are embedded in this notebook, so you do not need to upload separate .cpp or .cu files.

In [3]:
# Paper-faithful Bounty Hunter Optimizer (Yu et al., Knowl.-Based Syst. 341, 2026): shared core + sequential CPU + CUDA.
# bho_common.h holds every equation (Explorpolis, QPRS, K-means init, r_h feedback, reassignment) as
# host+device functions, so the CPU, OpenMP and CUDA builds run identical math and identical random streams.
import os

common_source = r'''// bho_common.h  --  Bounty Hunter Optimizer (Yu et al., Knowledge-Based Systems 341 (2026) 115836)
// Paper-faithful core shared by the sequential, OpenMP and CUDA drivers.
//
// Every per-hunter step is a BHO_HD (host+device) function, so the three back-ends execute the
// SAME equations with the SAME counter-based random numbers (results agree up to libm rounding).
//
// Paper -> code map
//   Sec 2.1.1  oversampling (10N pool)            bho_run_host / CUDA main : pool generation
//   Sec 2.1.2  K-means -> N centroids, K-means -> Ngroup groups   bho_kmeans
//   Eq 3-5     rank-ratio mode switch, r_h feedback, score         bho_phase2/3/5
//   Eq 6       thorough investigation                              bho_phase3 (mode 1)
//   Eq 7       reference-factor adaptation                         bho_phase3
//   Eq 8-9     rough search                                        bho_phase3 (mode 0)
//   Eq 10-11 + Explorpolis acceptance                              bho_phase4
//   Eq 12      hunter reassignment (MPPC)                          bho_phase3 (mode 2)
//   Eq 13-17 + Alg.1 + Table 1   QPRS                              bho_qprs / bho_phase1 / bho_phase5
//   Eq 15-16   group contribution                                  bho_phase1
//   Eq 18      movement factor m                                   bho_phase3
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

#ifdef __CUDACC__
#define BHO_HD __host__ __device__
#else
#define BHO_HD
#endif

#ifdef BHO_USE_OMP
#include <omp.h>
#define BHO_PARFOR _Pragma("omp parallel for schedule(static)")
#else
#define BHO_PARFOR
#endif

constexpr double BHO_PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
constexpr int BHO_MAXG = 16;     // max number of pursuit groups
constexpr int BHO_KM_ITERS = 8;  // Lloyd iterations for both K-means stages

struct Bench { const char* name; int id; double lb, ub; };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- configuration
struct BhoCfg {
    int D, N, max_iter;
    int Ngroup = 4;        // paper Sec.3: Ngroup = 4
    int mppc = 2;          // MPPC >= 2
    int guard_max = 64;    // QPRS finite-step guard
    int Ne = 1;            // elite-set size for Explorpolis (filled by bho_make_cfg)
    double rho = 0.25;     // contribution fading factor
    double tau = 0.3;      // Explorpolis radius (normalised RMS distance)
    double rh0 = 0.3;      // initial mode threshold r_h
    double elite_frac = 0.2;
    double lb, ub;
    int obj;
    unsigned seed;
};

// scalars shared between phases (lives in device memory for CUDA)
struct BhoGlobal {
    double rh, sumF;
    int gidx;      // index (into personal bests) of the global best clue
    int bestg;     // group with the highest cumulative contribution
    int last_sel;  // last group chosen by QPRS this iteration
    int nre;       // number of reassignments this iteration
    int first;     // 1 -> initialise QPRS amplitudes from C (Eq.14)
};

struct BhoState {
    BhoCfg c;
    double *X, *F, *Xn, *Fn;     // population (double-buffered) and fitness
    double *T, *FT;              // trial positions / fitness
    double *PB, *PBF;            // personal-best position / fitness
    double *CF;                  // N x 3 reference factors c1,c2,c3
    double *Rr, *cc, *score;     // rank ratio, hunter contribution, score
    double *Cg, *alpha, *beta;   // group contribution, qubit amplitudes
    int *grp, *ngrp, *P, *mode, *elite;
    int *gsize, *gstart, *gmem, *gb;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- RNG (counter based)
BHO_HD inline unsigned bho_hash(unsigned x) {
    x ^= x >> 16; x *= 0x7feb352dU; x ^= x >> 15; x *= 0x846ca68bU; x ^= x >> 16; return x;
}
BHO_HD inline double bho_rnd(unsigned seed, unsigned a, unsigned b, unsigned c) {
    unsigned x = bho_hash(seed ^ bho_hash(a * 0x9e3779b9U + 0x7f4a7c15U));
    x = bho_hash(x ^ bho_hash(b * 0x85ebca6bU + 0x165667b1U));
    x = bho_hash(x ^ (c * 0xc2b2ae35U + 0x27d4eb2fU));
    return (double)(x >> 8) * (1.0 / 16777216.0);
}
// stream tags (it*32 + tag)
enum { TG_R1 = 1, TG_R2 = 2, TG_R3 = 3, TG_PEER = 4, TG_QPRS = 5, TG_BETTER = 6, TG_SIGN = 7 };
BHO_HD inline double bho_rr(const BhoState& s, int i, int it, int tag, int j) {
    return bho_rnd(s.c.seed, (unsigned)i, (unsigned)(it * 32 + tag), (unsigned)j);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- benchmark functions

BHO_HD inline double bho_objective(const double* x, int D, int id) {
    double s = 0.0;

    // 0. Sphere
    if (id == 0) {
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++)
            s += x[j] * x[j];
        return s;
    }

    // 1. Rastrigin
    if (id == 1) {
        s = 10.0 * D;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++)
            s += x[j] * x[j] - 10.0 * cos(2.0 * BHO_PI * x[j]);
        return s;
    }

    // 2. Rosenbrock
    if (id == 2) {
        for (int j = 0; j < D - 1; j++) {
            double a = x[j + 1] - x[j] * x[j];
            double b = x[j] - 1.0;
            s += 100.0 * a * a + b * b;
        }
        return s;
    }

    // 3. Ackley
    if (id == 3) {
        double s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            s1 += x[j] * x[j];
            s2 += cos(2.0 * BHO_PI * x[j]);
        }
        return -20.0 * exp(-0.2 * sqrt(s1 / D))
               - exp(s2 / D) + 20.0 + exp(1.0);
    }

    // 4. Griewank
    if (id == 4) {
        double p = 1.0;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            s += x[j] * x[j] / 4000.0;
            p *= cos(x[j] / sqrt((double)(j + 1)));
        }
        return s - p + 1.0;
    }

    // 5. Schwefel
    if (id == 5) {
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++)
            s += x[j] * sin(sqrt(fabs(x[j])));
        return 418.9829 * D - s;
    }

    // 6. Zakharov
    if (id == 6) {
        double sum1 = 0.0, sum2 = 0.0;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            sum1 += x[j] * x[j];
            sum2 += 0.5 * (j + 1) * x[j];
        }
        return sum1 + sum2 * sum2
               + sum2 * sum2 * sum2 * sum2;
    }

    // 7. Levy
    if (id == 7) {
        double w1 = 1.0 + (x[0] - 1.0) / 4.0;
        double wd = 1.0 + (x[D - 1] - 1.0) / 4.0;

        double first = sin(BHO_PI * w1);
        s = first * first;

        for (int j = 0; j < D - 1; j++) {
            double w = 1.0 + (x[j] - 1.0) / 4.0;
            double wn = 1.0 + (x[j + 1] - 1.0) / 4.0;

            double term = w - 1.0;
            double sn = sin(BHO_PI * wn);

            s += term * term * (1.0 + 10.0 * sn * sn);
        }

        double last_sin = sin(2.0 * BHO_PI * wd);
        s += (wd - 1.0) * (wd - 1.0)
             * (1.0 + last_sin * last_sin);

        return s;
    }

    // 8. Alpine
    if (id == 8) {
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++)
            s += fabs(x[j] * sin(x[j]) + 0.1 * x[j]);
        return s;
    }

    // 9. Dixon-Price
    if (id == 9) {
        double term = x[0] - 1.0;
        s = term * term;

        for (int j = 1; j < D; j++) {
            double a = 2.0 * x[j] * x[j] - x[j - 1];
            s += (j + 1) * a * a;
        }
        return s;
    }

    return 1e100;
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------- QPRS (Algorithm 1)
BHO_HD inline int bho_qprs(const BhoState& s, int i, int it) {
    const int Ng = s.c.Ngroup;
    int phi[BHO_MAXG];
    for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) phi[l] = 0;
    int Ns = 0, guard = 0;
    unsigned ctr = 0;
    unsigned seed = s.c.seed, a = (unsigned)i, b = (unsigned)(it * 32 + TG_QPRS);
    while (Ns != 1 && guard < s.c.guard_max) {
        if (Ns == 0) {
            for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) if (phi[l] == 0) {
                double r = bho_rnd(seed, a, b, ctr++);
                if (r > s.alpha[l] * s.alpha[l]) { phi[l] = 1; Ns++; }
            }
        } else {
            for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) if (phi[l] == 1) {
                double r = bho_rnd(seed, a, b, ctr++);
                if (r <= s.alpha[l] * s.alpha[l]) { phi[l] = 0; Ns--; }
            }
        }
        guard++;
    }
    if (Ns != 1) {                                  // guardMAX fallback: random team
        int l = (int)(bho_rnd(seed, a, b, ctr++) * Ng);
        return l < Ng ? l : Ng - 1;
    }
    for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) if (phi[l]) return l;
    return 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 1 (serial, O(N))
// hunter/group contributions (Eq.15-16), QPRS init (Eq.14), group lists, group/global bests
BHO_HD inline void bho_phase1(const BhoState& s, BhoGlobal* G) {
    const int N = s.c.N, Ng = s.c.Ngroup;
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) sum += s.F[i];
    if (fabs(sum) < 1e-300) sum = (sum < 0 ? -1e-300 : 1e-300);
    G->sumF = sum;
    double gs[BHO_MAXG];
    for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) { gs[l] = 0.0; s.gsize[l] = 0; }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        s.cc[i] = 1.0 - s.F[i] / sum;                       // Eq.16
        s.gsize[s.grp[i]]++; gs[s.grp[i]] += s.cc[i];
    }
    for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) s.Cg[l] = (1.0 - s.c.rho) * s.Cg[l] + gs[l];   // Eq.15
    if (G->first) {                                          // Eq.14 (+ beta = sqrt(1-alpha^2))
        double tot = 0.0;
        for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) tot += s.Cg[l];
        for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) {
            double a = (tot > 0.0) ? s.Cg[l] / tot : 1.0 / Ng;
            a = fmin(1.0, fmax(0.0, a));
            s.alpha[l] = a; s.beta[l] = sqrt(1.0 - a * a);
        }
        G->first = 0;
    }
    int acc = 0;
    for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) { s.gstart[l] = acc; acc += s.gsize[l]; s.gb[l] = -1; }
    int fill[BHO_MAXG];
    for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) fill[l] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {                            // members in ascending index order
        int g = s.grp[i];
        s.gmem[s.gstart[g] + fill[g]++] = i;
        if (s.gb[g] < 0 || s.PBF[i] < s.PBF[s.gb[g]]) s.gb[g] = i;
    }
    int gi = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) if (s.PBF[i] < s.PBF[gi]) gi = i;
    G->gidx = gi;
    int bg = 0;
    for (int l = 1; l < Ng; l++) if (s.Cg[l] > s.Cg[bg]) bg = l;
    G->bestg = bg;
    G->nre = 0; G->last_sel = -1;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 2 (per hunter)
// rank ratio inside the subgroup (1/size = best) and global elite flag (top Ne of the population)
BHO_HD inline void bho_phase2(const BhoState& s, int i) {
    const int N = s.c.N;
    const int g = s.grp[i];
    const double fi = s.F[i];
    int rl = 0, rg = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
        bool lower = (s.F[j] < fi) || (s.F[j] == fi && j < i);
        if (lower) { rg++; if (s.grp[j] == g) rl++; }
    }
    s.Rr[i] = (rl + 1.0) / (double)s.gsize[g];
    s.elite[i] = (rg < s.c.Ne) ? 1 : 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 3 (per hunter)
// factor adaptation (Eq.7), MPPC/reassignment (Eq.12, QPRS), mode switch (Eq.3),
// candidate generation (Eq.6 / 8-9 / 12), bound handling, objective evaluation.
BHO_HD inline void bho_phase3(const BhoState& s, const BhoGlobal* G, int i, int it) {
    const BhoCfg& c = s.c;
    const int D = c.D, N = c.N;
    const double R = s.Rr[i];
    double* cf = s.CF + (size_t)3 * i;

    // ---- Eq.7 : adapt c1,c2,c3 according to rank ratio
    if (R <= 0.2 || R >= 0.8) {
        double cbar = (cf[0] + cf[1] + cf[2]) / 3.0;
        for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
            bool ge = cf[t] >= cbar;
            if (R <= 0.2) cf[t] = ge ? fmin(cf[t] + R / 10.0, 0.8) : fmax(cf[t] - R / 10.0, 0.2);
            else          cf[t] = !ge ? fmin(cf[t] + R / 10.0, 0.8) : fmax(cf[t] - R / 10.0, 0.2);
        }
    }

    // ---- poor-performance counter / reassignment
    const int g = s.grp[i];
    int ng = g, md;
    if (R > 0.8) s.P[i]++; else s.P[i] = 0;                  // "consecutively" bottom 20 %
    if (s.P[i] >= c.mppc) { s.P[i] = 0; ng = bho_qprs(s, i, it); md = 2; }
    else md = (R <= G->rh) ? 1 : 0;                           // Eq.3
    s.ngrp[i] = ng; s.mode[i] = md;

    // ---- Eq.18 movement factor
    double m = 1.0 - ((double)(it + 1) / (2.0 * c.max_iter)) * (s.F[i] / G->sumF);
    m = fmin(1.0, fmax(0.0, m));

    const double* xi = s.X + (size_t)i * D;
    double* ti = s.T + (size_t)i * D;
    const double span = c.ub - c.lb;
    (void)span;

    if (md >= 1) {
        const double* xg = s.PB + (size_t)G->gidx * D;
        int gbi = s.gb[ng]; if (gbi < 0) gbi = G->gidx;
        const double* xt = s.PB + (size_t)gbi * D;
        int bi = i;                                           // Eq.6 : personal best
        if (md == 2) {                                        // Eq.12: better hunter of the new group
            bi = gbi;
            int sz = s.gsize[ng];
            if (sz > 0) {
                int off = (int)(bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_BETTER, 0) * sz);
                for (int q = 0; q < sz; q++) {
                    int cand = s.gmem[s.gstart[ng] + (off + q) % sz];
                    if (cand != i && s.PBF[cand] < s.PBF[i]) { bi = cand; break; }
                }
            }
        }
        const double* xb = s.PB + (size_t)bi * D;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            double r1 = bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_R1, j), r2 = bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_R2, j), r3 = bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_R3, j);
            double t = xi[j] + m * (cf[0] * r1 * (xg[j] - xi[j]) + cf[1] * r2 * (xt[j] - xi[j]) + cf[2] * r3 * (xb[j] - xi[j]));
            ti[j] = fmin(c.ub, fmax(c.lb, t));
        }
    } else {                                                  // rough search
        int sz = s.gsize[g], peer;
        if (sz >= 2) {
            int q = (int)(bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_PEER, 0) * sz); if (q >= sz) q = sz - 1;
            peer = s.gmem[s.gstart[g] + q];
            if (peer == i) peer = s.gmem[s.gstart[g] + (q + 1) % sz];
        } else {
            peer = (int)(bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_PEER, 0) * N); if (peer >= N) peer = N - 1;
            if (peer == i) peer = (peer + 1) % N;
        }
        const double* xp = s.X + (size_t)peer * D;
        bool toward = s.F[peer] < s.F[i];                     // minimisation: move toward a better reference
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) {
            double r = bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_R1, j);            // Eq.8
            double rough = toward ? xi[j] + r * (xp[j] - xi[j]) : xi[j] - r * (xp[j] - xi[j]);
            double r1 = bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_R2, j), r2 = bho_rr(s, i, it, TG_R3, j);   // Eq.9
            double t = (r2 > 0.5) ? rough + m * r1 * rough : rough - m * r1 * rough;
            ti[j] = fmin(c.ub, fmax(c.lb, t));
        }
    }
    s.FT[i] = bho_objective(ti, D, c.obj);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 4 (per hunter)
// greedy acceptance, otherwise Explorpolis (Eq.10-11): a worse candidate is rejected only if an elite
// solution that is at least as good lies within normalised distance tau.
BHO_HD inline void bho_phase4(const BhoState& s, int i) {
    const BhoCfg& c = s.c;
    const int D = c.D, N = c.N;
    const double* xi = s.X + (size_t)i * D;
    const double* ti = s.T + (size_t)i * D;
    double* xo = s.Xn + (size_t)i * D;
    const double ft = s.FT[i], fi = s.F[i];
    bool accept = ft < fi;
    if (!accept) {
        bool reject = false;
        const double inv = 1.0 / (c.ub - c.lb);
        for (int e = 0; e < N && !reject; e++) {
            if (!s.elite[e] || !(s.F[e] <= ft)) continue;
            const double* xe = s.X + (size_t)e * D;
            double d2 = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) { double d = (ti[j] - xe[j]) * inv; d2 += d * d; }
            if (sqrt(d2 / D) <= c.tau) reject = true;         // Eq.10
        }
        accept = !reject;
    }
    if (accept) { for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) xo[j] = ti[j]; s.Fn[i] = ft; }
    else        { for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) xo[j] = xi[j]; s.Fn[i] = fi; }
    if (ft < s.PBF[i]) {                                      // personal best from every evaluated clue
        double* pb = s.PB + (size_t)i * D;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) pb[j] = ti[j];
        s.PBF[i] = ft;
    }
    s.score[i] = (s.Fn[i] < fi ? 1.0 : -1.0) / ((double)N * c.max_iter);     // Eq.5 (improvement -> +)
    s.grp[i] = s.ngrp[i];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 5 (serial, O(N))
// r_h self-feedback (Eq.4) and quantum rotation of the QPRS amplitudes (Eq.17, Table 1)
BHO_HD inline void bho_phase5(const BhoState& s, BhoGlobal* G, int it) {
    const int N = s.c.N, Ng = s.c.Ngroup;
    double dr = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (s.mode[i] >= 1) dr += s.score[i]; else dr -= s.score[i];
        if (s.mode[i] == 2) { G->last_sel = s.ngrp[i]; G->nre++; }
    }
    G->rh = fmin(0.95, fmax(0.05, G->rh + dr));
    if (G->nre > 0) {
        const double d = 0.01 * BHO_PI;
        const int bg = G->bestg;
        const int Qb = (G->last_sel == bg) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int l = 0; l < Ng; l++) {
            int Q = (G->last_sel == l) ? 1 : 0;
            bool cond = s.Cg[l] > s.Cg[bg];
            double a = s.alpha[l], b = s.beta[l];
            double th = 0.0;
            if (Q != Qb) {
                int col;                                      // 0: ab>0, 1: ab<0, 2: a==0, 3: b==0
                double ab = a * b;
                if (a == 0.0) col = 2; else if (b == 0.0) col = 3; else col = (ab > 0.0) ? 0 : 1;
                double sg = (bho_rnd(s.c.seed, (unsigned)l, (unsigned)(it * 32 + TG_SIGN), 0u) < 0.5) ? -d : d;
                bool q0 = (Q == 0);                           // rows (Q,Qbest,cond) of Table 1
                bool flip = (q0 == cond);                     // (0,1,T) and (1,0,F) are the "-,+" rows
                if (!flip) { th = (col == 0) ? d : (col == 1) ? -d : (col == 2) ? 0.0 : sg; }
                else       { th = (col == 0) ? -d : (col == 1) ? d : (col == 2) ? sg : 0.0; }
            }
            if (th != 0.0) {
                double ct = cos(th), st = sin(th);
                double na = a * ct - b * st, nb = a * st + b * ct;
                double nrm = sqrt(na * na + nb * nb);
                s.alpha[l] = na / nrm; s.beta[l] = nb / nrm;
            }
        }
    }
}

// ================================================================= HOST-ONLY: K-means + driver
inline void bho_kmeans(const double* data, int n, int D, int K, int iters, double* cent, int* asg) {
    for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
        size_t src = (size_t)(((long long)k * n) / K);
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) cent[(size_t)k * D + j] = data[src * D + j];
    }
    for (int it = 0; it <= iters; it++) {
        BHO_PARFOR
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const double* x = data + (size_t)i * D;
            int bk = 0; double bd = 1e300;
            for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
                const double* ck = cent + (size_t)k * D;
                double d2 = 0.0;
                for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) { double d = x[j] - ck[j]; d2 += d * d; }
                if (d2 < bd) { bd = d2; bk = k; }
            }
            asg[i] = bk;
        }
        if (it == iters) break;                               // final assignment pass only
        BHO_PARFOR
        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
            std::vector<double> acc(D, 0.0);
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (asg[i] == k) {
                const double* x = data + (size_t)i * D;
                for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) acc[j] += x[j];
                cnt++;
            }
            if (cnt > 0) for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) cent[(size_t)k * D + j] = acc[j] / cnt;
        }
    }
}

inline BhoCfg bho_make_cfg(int D, int N, int max_iter, const Bench& b, unsigned seed) {
    BhoCfg c; c.D = D; c.N = N; c.max_iter = max_iter;
    c.lb = b.lb; c.ub = b.ub; c.obj = b.id; c.seed = seed;
    if (c.Ngroup > N) c.Ngroup = N;
    c.Ne = std::max(1, (int)std::ceil(c.elite_frac * N));
    return c;
}

// Full sequential / OpenMP run (parallel loops are enabled by compiling with -DBHO_USE_OMP -fopenmp).
inline double bho_run_host(const BhoCfg& c) {
    const int N = c.N, D = c.D, Ng = c.Ngroup;
    std::vector<double> X((size_t)N * D), Xn((size_t)N * D), T((size_t)N * D), PB((size_t)N * D);
    std::vector<double> F(N), Fn(N), FT(N), PBF(N), CF((size_t)3 * N), Rr(N), cc(N), score(N);
    std::vector<double> Cg(Ng, 0.0), alpha(Ng), beta(Ng);
    std::vector<int> grp(N), ngrp(N), P(N, 0), mode(N), elite(N), gsize(Ng), gstart(Ng), gmem(N), gb(Ng);

    // Sec 2.1.1 oversampling + Sec 2.1.2 K-means (10N pool -> N centroids)
    const int NP = 10 * N;
    std::vector<double> pool((size_t)NP * D);
    std::vector<int> pasg(NP);
    BHO_PARFOR
    for (int i = 0; i < NP; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) pool[(size_t)i * D + j] = c.lb + (c.ub - c.lb) * bho_rnd(c.seed, (unsigned)i, 0x7777u, (unsigned)j);
    bho_kmeans(pool.data(), NP, D, N, BHO_KM_ITERS, X.data(), pasg.data());
    BHO_PARFOR
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        F[i] = bho_objective(&X[(size_t)i * D], D, c.obj);
        PBF[i] = F[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) PB[(size_t)i * D + j] = X[(size_t)i * D + j];
        for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) CF[(size_t)3 * i + t] = bho_rnd(c.seed, (unsigned)i, 0xCCCCu, (unsigned)t);
    }
    // group construction: K-means of the population into Ngroup pursuit groups
    std::vector<double> gcent((size_t)Ng * D);
    bho_kmeans(X.data(), N, D, Ng, BHO_KM_ITERS, gcent.data(), grp.data());

    BhoGlobal G{}; G.rh = c.rh0; G.first = 1;
    BhoState s{};
    s.c = c;
    s.X = X.data(); s.F = F.data(); s.Xn = Xn.data(); s.Fn = Fn.data(); s.T = T.data(); s.FT = FT.data();
    s.PB = PB.data(); s.PBF = PBF.data(); s.CF = CF.data(); s.Rr = Rr.data(); s.cc = cc.data(); s.score = score.data();
    s.Cg = Cg.data(); s.alpha = alpha.data(); s.beta = beta.data();
    s.grp = grp.data(); s.ngrp = ngrp.data(); s.P = P.data(); s.mode = mode.data(); s.elite = elite.data();
    s.gsize = gsize.data(); s.gstart = gstart.data(); s.gmem = gmem.data(); s.gb = gb.data();

    for (int it = 0; it < c.max_iter; it++) {
        bho_phase1(s, &G);
        BHO_PARFOR for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) bho_phase2(s, i);
        BHO_PARFOR for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) bho_phase3(s, &G, i, it);
        BHO_PARFOR for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) bho_phase4(s, i);
        bho_phase5(s, &G, it);
        std::swap(s.X, s.Xn); std::swap(s.F, s.Fn);
    }
    double best = PBF[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) best = std::min(best, PBF[i]);
    return best;
}

inline void bho_benchmarks(Bench out[10]) {
    Bench t[10] = {
        {"Sphere",       0, -100.0, 100.0},
        {"Rastrigin",    1, -5.12, 5.12},
        {"Rosenbrock",   2, -30.0, 30.0},
        {"Ackley",       3, -32.768, 32.768},
        {"Griewank",     4, -600.0, 600.0},
        {"Schwefel",     5, -500.0, 500.0},
        {"Zakharov",     6, -5.0, 10.0},
        {"Levy",         7, -10.0, 10.0},
        {"Alpine",       8, -10.0, 10.0},
        {"DixonPrice",   9, -10.0, 10.0}
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
        out[i] = t[i];
}

'''

cpu_source = r'''// Sequential (single-thread) Bounty Hunter Optimizer -- paper-faithful implementation.
// Build : g++ -O3 -std=c++17 bho_cpu_comparison.cpp -o bho_cpu
// Run   : ./bho_cpu D N iterations repeats      (defaults 30 256 300 3)
#include <chrono>
#include <iomanip>
#include "bho_common.h"

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int D = argc > 1 ? std::atoi(argv[1]) : 30;
    int N = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : 256;
    int max_iter = argc > 3 ? std::atoi(argv[3]) : 300;
    int repeats = argc > 4 ? std::atoi(argv[4]) : 3;
    if (D < 2 || N < 4 || max_iter < 1 || repeats < 1) { std::cerr << "Usage: ./bho_cpu D N iterations repeats\n"; return 1; }
    Bench tests[10]; bho_benchmarks(tests);
    std::cout << "function,dimension,population,repeat,best_score,seconds\n";
    for (const auto& b : tests) for (int rep = 0; rep < repeats; rep++) {
        unsigned seed = 12345u + (unsigned)rep * 101u + (unsigned)b.id * 1009u;
        BhoCfg c = bho_make_cfg(D, N, max_iter, b, seed);
        auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        double best = bho_run_host(c);
        double sec = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
        std::cout << b.name << "," << D << "," << N << "," << rep << "," << std::setprecision(12) << best << "," << sec << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
'''

cuda_source = r'''// GPU-resident Bounty Hunter Optimizer (CUDA C++) -- paper-faithful implementation.
// Same equations, same counter-based RNG and same K-means as bho_cpu_comparison.cpp / bho_openmp.cpp
// (all per-hunter math lives in bho_common.h as __host__ __device__ functions).
//
// Everything stays on the GPU: oversampling pool, K-means (both stages), population, personal/group/global
// bests, QPRS state, Explorpolis acceptance. Only the final best score is copied back.
// Per-iteration kernels:  phase1 (1 thread, O(N)) -> phase2/3/4 (1 thread per hunter) -> phase5 (1 thread, O(N)).
//
// Build : nvcc -O3 -std=c++17 bho_cuda_gpu_resident.cu -o bho_cuda      (add -arch=sm_XX for your GPU)
// Run   : ./bho_cuda D N iterations repeats       (defaults 30 256 300 3)
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <chrono>
#include <iomanip>
#include "bho_common.h"

#define CUDA_CHECK(call) do { cudaError_t e_ = (call); if (e_ != cudaSuccess) { \
    std::cerr << "CUDA error: " << cudaGetErrorString(e_) << " at " << __FILE__ << ":" << __LINE__ << "\n"; \
    std::exit(2); } } while (0)

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- K-means kernels
__global__ void k_copy_init_centroids(const double* data, int n, int D, int K, double* cent) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx >= K * D) return;
    int k = idx / D, j = idx % D;
    size_t src = (size_t)(((long long)k * n) / K);
    cent[(size_t)k * D + j] = data[src * D + j];
}
__global__ void k_kmeans_assign(const double* data, int n, int D, int K, const double* cent, int* asg) {
    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (i >= n) return;
    const double* x = data + (size_t)i * D;
    int bk = 0; double bd = 1e300;
    for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
        const double* ck = cent + (size_t)k * D;
        double d2 = 0.0;
        for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) { double d = x[j] - ck[j]; d2 += d * d; }
        if (d2 < bd) { bd = d2; bk = k; }
    }
    asg[i] = bk;
}
// one thread per (cluster, dimension); sums members in ascending index order (matches the CPU order)
__global__ void k_kmeans_update(const double* data, int n, int D, int K, const int* asg, double* cent) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx >= K * D) return;
    int k = idx / D, j = idx % D;
    double acc = 0.0; int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (asg[i] == k) { acc += data[(size_t)i * D + j]; cnt++; }
    if (cnt > 0) cent[(size_t)k * D + j] = acc / cnt;
}
static void gpu_kmeans(const double* data, int n, int D, int K, int iters, double* cent, int* asg) {
    const int th = 128;
    k_copy_init_centroids<<<(K * D + th - 1) / th, th>>>(data, n, D, K, cent);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    for (int it = 0; it <= iters; it++) {
        k_kmeans_assign<<<(n + th - 1) / th, th>>>(data, n, D, K, cent, asg);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
        if (it == iters) break;
        k_kmeans_update<<<(K * D + th - 1) / th, th>>>(data, n, D, K, asg, cent);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- init kernels
__global__ void k_gen_pool(double* pool, int NP, int D, double lb, double ub, unsigned seed) {
    size_t idx = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx >= (size_t)NP * D) return;
    int i = (int)(idx / D), j = (int)(idx % D);
    pool[idx] = lb + (ub - lb) * bho_rnd(seed, (unsigned)i, 0x7777u, (unsigned)j);
}
__global__ void k_init_pop(BhoState s) {
    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (i >= s.c.N) return;
    const int D = s.c.D;
    s.F[i] = bho_objective(s.X + (size_t)i * D, D, s.c.obj);
    s.PBF[i] = s.F[i];
    for (int j = 0; j < D; j++) s.PB[(size_t)i * D + j] = s.X[(size_t)i * D + j];
    for (int t = 0; t < 3; t++) s.CF[(size_t)3 * i + t] = bho_rnd(s.c.seed, (unsigned)i, 0xCCCCu, (unsigned)t);
    s.P[i] = 0;
}
__global__ void k_init_group_state(BhoState s, BhoGlobal* G) {
    if (blockIdx.x || threadIdx.x) return;
    for (int l = 0; l < s.c.Ngroup; l++) s.Cg[l] = 0.0;
    G->rh = s.c.rh0; G->first = 1; G->sumF = 1.0; G->gidx = 0; G->bestg = 0; G->last_sel = -1; G->nre = 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- per-iteration kernels
__global__ void k_phase1(BhoState s, BhoGlobal* G) { if (blockIdx.x || threadIdx.x) return; bho_phase1(s, G); }
__global__ void k_phase2(BhoState s) { int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (i < s.c.N) bho_phase2(s, i); }
__global__ void k_phase3(BhoState s, const BhoGlobal* G, int it) { int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (i < s.c.N) bho_phase3(s, G, i, it); }
__global__ void k_phase4(BhoState s) { int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; if (i < s.c.N) bho_phase4(s, i); }
__global__ void k_phase5(BhoState s, BhoGlobal* G, int it) { if (blockIdx.x || threadIdx.x) return; bho_phase5(s, G, it); }
__global__ void k_best(const double* PBF, int N, double* out) {
    if (blockIdx.x || threadIdx.x) return;
    double b = PBF[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) if (PBF[i] < b) b = PBF[i];
    *out = b;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- host driver
struct DevBuf {
    std::vector<void*> ptrs;
    template <class T> T* alloc(size_t n) { void* p = nullptr; CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&p, n * sizeof(T))); CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(p, 0, n * sizeof(T))); ptrs.push_back(p); return (T*)p; }
    ~DevBuf() { for (void* p : ptrs) cudaFree(p); }
};

static double g_last_seconds = 0.0;   // timing of the last run_cuda() call (init + loop, excludes cudaMalloc)

static double run_cuda(const BhoCfg& c) {
    const int N = c.N, D = c.D, Ng = c.Ngroup, th = 128, blocks = (N + th - 1) / th;
    DevBuf B;
    BhoState s{};
    s.c = c;
    s.X = B.alloc<double>((size_t)N * D); s.Xn = B.alloc<double>((size_t)N * D);
    s.T = B.alloc<double>((size_t)N * D); s.PB = B.alloc<double>((size_t)N * D);
    s.F = B.alloc<double>(N); s.Fn = B.alloc<double>(N); s.FT = B.alloc<double>(N); s.PBF = B.alloc<double>(N);
    s.CF = B.alloc<double>((size_t)3 * N); s.Rr = B.alloc<double>(N); s.cc = B.alloc<double>(N); s.score = B.alloc<double>(N);
    s.Cg = B.alloc<double>(Ng); s.alpha = B.alloc<double>(Ng); s.beta = B.alloc<double>(Ng);
    s.grp = B.alloc<int>(N); s.ngrp = B.alloc<int>(N); s.P = B.alloc<int>(N); s.mode = B.alloc<int>(N); s.elite = B.alloc<int>(N);
    s.gsize = B.alloc<int>(Ng); s.gstart = B.alloc<int>(Ng); s.gmem = B.alloc<int>(N); s.gb = B.alloc<int>(Ng);
    BhoGlobal* dG = B.alloc<BhoGlobal>(1);
    double* dBest = B.alloc<double>(1);
    const int NP = 10 * N;
    double* pool = B.alloc<double>((size_t)NP * D);
    int* pasg = B.alloc<int>(NP);
    double* gcent = B.alloc<double>((size_t)Ng * D);

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    // Sec 2.1.1 / 2.1.2 : oversampling + K-means (10N -> N), then K-means grouping
    k_gen_pool<<<(unsigned)(((size_t)NP * D + 255) / 256), 256>>>(pool, NP, D, c.lb, c.ub, c.seed);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    gpu_kmeans(pool, NP, D, N, BHO_KM_ITERS, s.X, pasg);
    k_init_pop<<<blocks, th>>>(s);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    gpu_kmeans(s.X, N, D, Ng, BHO_KM_ITERS, gcent, s.grp);
    k_init_group_state<<<1, 1>>>(s, dG);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());

    for (int it = 0; it < c.max_iter; it++) {
        k_phase1<<<1, 1>>>(s, dG);
        k_phase2<<<blocks, th>>>(s);
        k_phase3<<<blocks, th>>>(s, dG, it);
        k_phase4<<<blocks, th>>>(s);
        k_phase5<<<1, 1>>>(s, dG, it);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
        std::swap(s.X, s.Xn); std::swap(s.F, s.Fn);
    }
    k_best<<<1, 1>>>(s.PBF, N, dBest);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    auto t1 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    double best = 0.0;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&best, dBest, sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    g_last_seconds = std::chrono::duration<double>(t1 - t0).count();
    return best;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int D = argc > 1 ? std::atoi(argv[1]) : 30;
    int N = argc > 2 ? std::atoi(argv[2]) : 256;
    int max_iter = argc > 3 ? std::atoi(argv[3]) : 300;
    int repeats = argc > 4 ? std::atoi(argv[4]) : 3;
    if (D < 2 || N < 4 || max_iter < 1 || repeats < 1) { std::cerr << "Usage: ./bho_cuda D N iterations repeats\n"; return 1; }
    int device = 0; cudaDeviceProp prop{};
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device)); CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));
    std::cerr << "GPU," << prop.name << "\n";
    Bench tests[10]; bho_benchmarks(tests);
    std::cout << "function,dimension,population,repeat,best_score,seconds\n";
    for (const auto& b : tests) for (int rep = 0; rep < repeats; rep++) {
        unsigned seed = 12345u + (unsigned)rep * 101u + (unsigned)b.id * 1009u;
        BhoCfg c = bho_make_cfg(D, N, max_iter, b, seed);
        double best = run_cuda(c);
        std::cout << b.name << "," << D << "," << N << "," << rep << "," << std::setprecision(12) << best << "," << g_last_seconds << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
'''

# Create the OpenMP implementation from the same sequential source (same algorithm, same benchmark functions).
# The parallel loops are the BHO_PARFOR markers inside bho_common.h (K-means assignment/update, pool generation,
# population init, and the per-hunter phases 2/3/4). Defining BHO_USE_OMP turns them into
# "#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)". Serial parts: phase 1 and phase 5 (O(N) bookkeeping), best scans.
import os

omp_source = cpu_source.replace(
"#include <chrono>",
"#define BHO_USE_OMP\n#include <chrono>"
).replace(
"    Bench tests[6]; bho_benchmarks(tests);",
"    int threads = argc > 5 ? std::atoi(argv[5]) : 0;\n"
"    if (threads > 0) omp_set_num_threads(threads);\n"
"    std::cerr << \"OpenMP threads,\" << omp_get_max_threads() << \"\\n\";\n"
"    Bench tests[6]; bho_benchmarks(tests);"
).replace(
"        auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();",
"        double t0 = omp_get_wtime();"
).replace(
"        double sec = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();",
"        double sec = omp_get_wtime() - t0;"
).replace("./bho_cpu D N iterations repeats", "./bho_omp D N iterations repeats [threads]")

if omp_source == cpu_source or omp_source.count("omp_get_wtime") != 2 or "#define BHO_USE_OMP" not in omp_source:
    raise RuntimeError("OpenMP source transformation failed.")
with open("bho_openmp.cpp", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(omp_source)

n_loops = common_source.count("BHO_PARFOR")
print("Created bho_openmp.cpp (needs bho_common.h); parallel-loop markers in header:", n_loops - 2)
print("Build: g++ -O3 -std=c++17 -fopenmp bho_openmp.cpp -o bho_omp")

Build: g++ -O3 -std=c++17 -fopenmp bho_openmp.cpp -o bho_omp

3. Compile sequential, OpenMP, and CUDA programs¶

The OpenMP version uses g++ -fopenmp. It parallelizes independent population-level loops while keeping the algorithm and benchmark functions aligned with the sequential baseline. CUDA is compiled with nvcc.

$ g++ -O3 -std=c++17 bho_cpu_comparison.cpp -o bho_cpu


$ g++ -O3 -std=c++17 -fopenmp bho_openmp.cpp -o bho_openmp


$ nvcc -O3 -std=c++17 bho_cuda_gpu_resident.cu -o bho_cuda


Sequential, OpenMP, and CUDA programs compiled successfully.

4. Run benchmark trials¶

All three implementations use the same benchmark functions, dimensions, population size, iteration count, and repeat count. OpenMP thread count can be adjusted with OMP_NUM_THREADS.

In [6]:
# Recommended first run; increase after checking that everything works.
D = 500
POPULATION = 1024
ITERATIONS = 300
REPEATS = 3
OMP_THREADS = 8  # Change to the number of CPU threads you want to test
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = str(OMP_THREADS)

def run_program(executable, label):
    cmd = ["./" + executable, str(D), str(POPULATION), str(ITERATIONS), str(REPEATS)]
    print(f"Running {label}: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    proc_env = os.environ.copy()
    proc_env["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = str(OMP_THREADS)
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=proc_env)
    if proc.stderr:
        print(proc.stderr)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print(proc.stdout)
        proc.check_returncode()
    df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(proc.stdout))
    df["implementation"] = label
    return df

cpu_results = run_program("bho_cpu", "CPU")
omp_results = run_program("bho_openmp", "OpenMP")
gpu_results = run_program("bho_cuda", "CUDA GPU")
results = pd.concat([cpu_results, omp_results, gpu_results], ignore_index=True)
display(results)
print("OpenMP threads:", OMP_THREADS)

5. Summary table and speedup¶

Speedup is CPU time / CUDA time. A value above 1 means CUDA is faster. Timing includes the optimization kernels and synchronization; GPU memory allocation is outside the timed loop. Small tests may be dominated by kernel-launch overhead.

In [7]:
summary = (results.groupby(["function", "implementation"])
           .agg(mean_best_score=("best_score", "mean"),
                std_best_score=("best_score", "std"),
                mean_seconds=("seconds", "mean"),
                std_seconds=("seconds", "std"))
           .reset_index())
display(summary)

times = summary.pivot(index="function", columns="implementation", values="mean_seconds")
scores = summary.pivot(index="function", columns="implementation", values="mean_best_score")
comparison = pd.DataFrame(index=times.index)
comparison["CPU mean seconds"] = times["CPU"]
comparison["OpenMP mean seconds"] = times["OpenMP"]
comparison["CUDA mean seconds"] = times["CUDA GPU"]
comparison["Speedup CPU/OpenMP"] = comparison["CPU mean seconds"] / times["OpenMP"]
comparison["Speedup CPU/CUDA"] = comparison["CPU mean seconds"] / times["CUDA GPU"]
comparison["CPU mean score"] = scores["CPU"]
comparison["OpenMP mean score"] = scores["OpenMP"]
comparison["CUDA mean score"] = scores["CUDA GPU"]
display(comparison.reset_index())

results.to_csv("bho_cpu_openmp_cuda_raw_trials.csv", index=False)
summary.to_csv("bho_cpu_openmp_cuda_summary.csv", index=False)
comparison.to_csv("bho_cpu_openmp_cuda_comparison.csv")

6. Comparison graphs¶

The score plots are separated by benchmark because their objective-value scales differ substantially.

In [20]:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Number of benchmark functions
num_functions = len(times.index)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Runtime comparison: Sequential vs OpenMP vs CUDA
# --------------------------------------------------

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    figsize=(max(12, num_functions * 1.5), 6)
)

times.plot(
    kind="bar",
    ax=ax,
    width=0.75
)

ax.set_title(
    f"Sequential vs OpenMP vs CUDA BHO Optimizer Runtime\n"
    f"(D={D}, N={POPULATION}, Iterations={ITERATIONS})",
    fontsize=14
)

ax.set_ylabel("Mean Wall-Clock Time (seconds)")
ax.set_xlabel("Benchmark")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=30)
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), ha="right")
ax.legend(title="Implementation")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()


# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Parallel speedup comparison
# --------------------------------------------------

speedup_cols = [
    "Speedup CPU/OpenMP",
    "Speedup CPU/CUDA"
]

speedup_cols = [
    col for col in speedup_cols
    if col in comparison.columns
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    figsize=(max(12, num_functions * 1.5), 6)
)

comparison[speedup_cols].plot(
    kind="bar",
    ax=ax,
    width=0.75
)

ax.axhline(
    1.0,
    linestyle="--",
    color="black",
    label="No speedup"
)

    "Parallel Speedup: Sequential CPU vs OpenMP vs CUDA",
    fontsize=14
)

ax.set_ylabel("Speedup (Higher is Better)")
ax.set_xlabel("Benchmark")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=30)
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), ha="right")
ax.legend(title="Comparison")

plt.show()


# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Optimization score comparison (3 x 3)
# --------------------------------------------------

functions = list(scores.index)

ncols = 3
nrows = int(np.ceil(len(functions) / ncols))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    nrows,
    ncols,
    figsize=(15, 3.8 * nrows),
    squeeze=False
)

for i, fn in enumerate(functions):

    ax = axes.flat[i]

    scores.loc[fn].plot(
        kind="bar",
        ax=ax,
        width=0.7
    )

    ax.set_title(fn, fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel("Mean Best Score (Lower is Better)")
    ax.set_xlabel("Implementation")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=20)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)

# Hide unused subplot spaces
for ax in axes.flat[len(functions):]:
    ax.set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle(
    "Optimization Score Comparison: Sequential vs OpenMP vs CUDA",
    fontsize=16,
    y=1.01
)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

    c for c in ["Speedup CPU/OpenMP", "Speedup CPU/CUDA"]
    if c in comparison.columns
]

if len(sp_cols) > 0:

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, 2,
        figsize=(max(13, num_benchmarks * 1.5), 6),
        gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.5, 1]}
    )

    speedup_values = comparison[sp_cols].values

    im = axes[0].imshow(
        speedup_values,
        aspect="auto",
        cmap="viridis"
    )

    axes[0].set_xticks(range(len(sp_cols)))
    axes[0].set_xticklabels(
        [c.replace("Speedup ", "") for c in sp_cols]
    )

    axes[0].set_yticks(range(num_benchmarks))
    axes[0].set_yticklabels(comparison.index)

    for i in range(speedup_values.shape[0]):
        for j in range(speedup_values.shape[1]):
            axes[0].text(
                j, i,
                f"{speedup_values[i, j]:.2f}x",
                ha="center", va="center",
                color="white", fontsize=9
            )

    axes[0].set_title("Speedup per Benchmark")
    fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes[0], label="Speedup")

    # Geometric mean (ignore non-positive values)
    valid = comparison[sp_cols].where(comparison[sp_cols] > 0)
    gm = np.exp(np.log(valid).mean())

    bars = axes[1].bar(
        [c.replace("Speedup ", "") for c in sp_cols],
        gm.values
    )

    axes[1].bar_label(
        bars,
        labels=[f"{v:.2f}x" for v in gm.values]
    )

    axes[1].axhline(1.0, linestyle="--", color="black")
    axes[1].set_title("Geometric Mean Speedup")
    axes[1].set_ylabel("Speedup over Sequential")
    axes[1].grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

bars = ax.bar(total.index, total.values)

scores.plot(
    kind="bar",
    ax=ax,
    width=0.75
)

ax.set_yscale("symlog", linthresh=1e-12)
ax.set_title("Mean Best Score per Benchmark (Symlog Scale)", fontsize=15)
ax.set_ylabel("Mean Best Score (Lower is Better)")
ax.set_xlabel("Benchmark")
ax.set_xticklabels(scores.index, rotation=30, ha="right")

ax.legend(title="Implementation")

# 7. Runtime relative to the fastest implementation

ax = rel.plot(
    kind="bar",
    figsize=(FIG_WIDTH, 6),
    width=0.75
)

ax.axhline(1.0, linestyle="--", color="black")
ax.set_title(
    "Runtime Relative to Fastest Implementation",
    fontsize=15
)
ax.set_ylabel("Time / Fastest Time (Lower is Better)")
ax.set_xlabel("Benchmark")
ax.set_xticklabels(times.index, rotation=30, ha="right")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(title="Implementation")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

7. Scaling experiments and reporting¶

  • First verify the run at D=30, N=256.
  • Then try D=100, N=512 and D=300, N=1024 if runtime allows.
  • Keep ITERATIONS and REPEATS identical between Sequential, OpenMP, and CUDA.
  • Set OMP_THREADS = 4 in the benchmark cell to control the number of OpenMP CPU threads.
  • Report CPU/GPU model, thread count, dimension, population, iterations, repeats, mean runtime, speedup, and mean/std best score.
  • The best score is stochastic and may not match the known optimum. Runtime alone does not establish optimization quality.
  • The CUDA implementation is GPU-resident, while the OpenMP version uses shared-memory CPU parallelism. Compare end-to-end wall-clock time.
  • Note: these implementations are a BHO-inspired comparison variant, not a line-by-line reproduction of every mechanism in the paper (K-means, QPRS, and Explorpolis).
